name: Open Institutional Custody
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake mold pkg-config clang curl jq && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
postCreateCommand: rustup toolchain install 1.95 && rustup default 1.95 && rustc --version && CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 cargo build -p oic-cli
postAttachCommand: echo 'Run the custody demo:  cargo run -p oic-cli -- demo'
